integrity: The proof reduces the fort condition to the exact number of selected vertices outside each part, classifies inclusion-minimal obstructions, then derives hypergraph matching and fractional-transversal formulas. A separate exhaustive checker tests the fort definition, inclusion minimality, maximum disjoint-fort matching, and fractional fort-cover LP on every connected complete multipartite type through order ten.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to standard zero-forcing forts on connected complete multipartite graphs.
The complete-bipartite and star special cases of fort number and fractional zero forcing are prior results.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed complete-multipartite treatments.
title: Minimal forts and fractional zero forcing of complete multipartite graphs
